hello.label: Hello
hello.text: I'm Max — an engineer who builds with AI, but doesn't let it do the thinking. I know the fundamentals: how to structure components, architecture and state, and how to cut re-renders, bundle size and load time. So every line AI writes for me, I can read, fix, and tell when it's wrong. Eight years in marketing taught me the rest: what people actually need.

story.label: Story
story.title: A marketer, a planner and an engineer
story.quote: From the pitch to the launch, I can carry the whole project.
body: I spent my first eight years in marketing and the nonprofit world: planning fundraising campaigns and campus events, writing government tender bids and partnership proposals, bringing companies and local partners together, and producing ads and video. That taught me how a project gets proposed, how it wins people over, and how it lands on budget and on time.

Then I became a frontend engineer. For over two years I have built SaaS products with React and Next.js, shipped two iOS apps to the App Store on my own, and turned teams' needs into AI automations and tools.

Engineers who understand marketing are rare; planners who can write code are rarer. I can think through how something will be built while it is still a proposal, and remember who it is for while I am building it. With the brief, the plan and the code in one person, less gets lost along the way.

items.company: E-Sheng Information (Assigned to III Digital Transformation Dept.)
items.description: Lead the frontend of products including AI Research, Agent Fabric and LandScape, from clarifying requirements and assessing feasibility to production launch, for public-sector and enterprise clients. Built SSE streaming that renders Deep Research reports as they arrive, split state with Jotai so the relationship graph no longer recomputes in full, and set up an AI workflow with Claude Code: brief → spec → review → build → test → commit.

Studied React, Next.js and TypeScript in the AppWorks School training program, building a blog-style SPA online diary and an e-commerce site on my own, with Firebase and GSAP for immersive interactions.

Led large government tender projects single-handedly, from writing the proposal through budget execution, resource allocation and vendor coordination to the final results presentation. Served as the single point of contact between external partners and internal teams, and planned 40+ campus advocacy talks connecting schools with local businesses.

Ran member recruitment and event planning, hosting general assemblies, tech forums and parenting talks. Produced Facebook live interview shows end to end, from planning and on-site filming to OBS directing.

Planned offline and online fundraising campaigns, managed social media and built cross-industry partnerships. Pitched and secured donations of NT$1.2M from Rotary and NT$300K from Qualcomm; a KOL campaign reached nearly 120,000 people and earned 15,000 likes.
Production assistant for commercials, TV programs and web videos, where my skills in video planning and on-set execution began.

story.label: Story
story.title: 懂行銷、會企劃，也寫得出程式
story.quote: 從提案、企劃到上線，一個人就能接起整個專案。
body: 我的前八年在行銷與非營利領域：策劃募款與校園活動、撰寫政府標案與合作提案、串起企業與在地的異業結盟，也做過廣告與影片的執行製作。這些經驗讓我知道一個專案怎麼被提出、怎麼說服人，又怎麼在預算和時程內落地。
後來我轉職成前端工程師，兩年多來用 React、Next.js 打造 SaaS 產品，一個人把兩款 iOS App 送上 App Store，也把團隊的需求做成 AI 自動化流程與工具。
懂行銷的工程師不多，會寫程式的企劃更少。我能在提案階段就想清楚要怎麼做，也能在開發時記得是為誰而做；需求、企劃和技術都在同一個人身上，傳遞中流失的就最少。

items.company: 易勝資訊 (委派至資策會數位轉型部門)
items.description: 主導 AI 快研究、Agent Fabric、LandScape 等產品的前端，從需求釐清、技術評估到正式上線，客戶為公部門與企業。實作 Deep Research 的 SSE 串流即時呈現研究報告，以 Jotai 拆分狀態避免關係圖整張重算，並用 Claude Code 建立「需求 → spec → 檢視 → 開發 → 測試 → commit」的 AI 協作流程。
在 AppWorks School 培訓計畫中系統性學習 React、Next.js 與 TypeScript，獨立完成部落格式 SPA 線上日記「疼痛收容所」與電商網站，並以 Firebase、GSAP 打造沉浸式互動體驗。
主責大型政府標案，從撰寫計畫書、掌握預算執行、資源調度與廠商協調到最後的成果發表，全部由一人執行；擔任內外部單一窗口對齊需求與期待，並規劃 40 場以上校園主題宣講，串連學校與在地企業合作。

items.company: 社團法人青年都會再生協會
items.description: 負責會員招募與活動策劃，舉辦會員大會、科技論壇與親職座談；FB 人物專訪直播從企劃、現場拍攝到 OBS 導播一手包辦。
策劃實體與線上募款活動、經營社群並推動異業結盟；成功提案爭取扶輪社 120 萬、高通國際 30 萬捐款，KOL 合作企劃觸及近 12 萬人次、帶來 1.5 萬次按讚。
參與廣告、電視節目與網路影片的執行製作，也是我影像企劃與現場執行能力的起點。
